metadata.processing_notes: Comprehensive extraction from Colonial Office List 1896 following EXTRACTION_METHODOLOGY.md. All entity types extracted with complete details: geographic entities, people (with full titles, honors, salaries, allowances), institutions (with composition details), economic data (revenue, expenditure, trade), infrastructure (railways, telegraphs with specifications), demographics (census data with breakdowns), and historical events. Historical spelling preserved throughout. Relationships mapped between entities.
metadata.extraction_methodology: Followed json_schema_template.json structure. Extracted only explicitly present information. Preserved historical spelling (e.g., 'honour', 'labour'). Included complete salary details with all allowances. Recorded specific dates, amounts with units and currency. Built relationships between entities.
notable_patterns: Governor salaries range from 500 pounds (St. Helena) to 5,000 pounds (British Guiana, Malta)
Most colonies have Executive and Legislative Councils with varying compositions
Railways predominantly government-owned with detailed financial data
Population census data shows gender breakdowns and often ethnic/racial categories using historical terminology
Historical events frequently involve territorial transfers, discoveries, and constitutional changes
Economic data consistently includes revenue, expenditure, imports, exports for years 1885-1894
